validated_results.title: Design and baseline characteristics of the osteoporotic fractures in men (MrOS) study--a large observational study of the determinants of fracture in older men.
validated_results.reason: This is a cohort design and baseline characteristics description ("The Osteoporotic Fractures in Men (MrOS) Study is a prospective cohort study designed to examine...") reporting no alcohol-prostate cancer incidence results.

validated_results.title: Role of mammalian lignans in the prevention and treatment of prostate cancer.
validated_results.reason: The article is a narrative review of lignans in prostate cancer ("This article outlines the possible role of lignans in prostate cancer by reviewing the current in vitro and in vivo evidence").

validated_results.title: A preliminary investigation of the enzymatic inhibition of 5alpha-reduction and growth of prostatic carcinoma cell line LNCap-FGC by natural astaxanthin and Saw Palmetto lipid extract in vitro.
validated_results.reason: The study is exclusively in vitro using a prostatic carcinoma cell line ("growth of prostatic carcinoma cells in vitro") with no human incidence data.

validated_results.title: Molecular chemoprevention by selenium: a genomic approach.
validated_results.reason: The article is explicitly a review of molecular mechanisms ("This mini-review focuses only on the elucidation of the molecular mechanisms of cancer prevention by selenium").

validated_results.title: Vitamin-D receptor (VDR) gene (Fok-I, Taq-I and Apa-I) polymorphisms in healthy individuals from north Indian population.
validated_results.journal: Asian Pacific journal of cancer prevention : APJCP
validated_results.reason: The study reports only VDR gene polymorphism frequencies in healthy individuals ("to determine the distribution of VDR gene (Fok-I, Taq-I and Apa-I) polymorphisms") with no vitamin D exposure estimate for prostate cancer incidence.

validated_results.title: Leptin gene polymorphisms and their phenotypic associations.
validated_results.reason: The report centers on a genotype-stratified or gene-exposure interaction, which this protocol excludes.

validated_results.title: Protective effects of black tea extract on testosterone induced oxidative damage in prostate.
validated_results.reason: The experiment was conducted exclusively in rats ("the antioxidative potential of black tea extract against androgen mediated oxidative stress in male Wistar rats").

validated_results.title: Differential attenuation of oxidative/nitrosative injuries in early prostatic neoplastic lesions in TRAMP mice by dietary antioxidants.
validated_results.reason: The study used a transgenic mouse model only ("The TRAMP (Transgenic Adenocarcinoma of the Mouse Prostate) mouse model was used").
